name: Image Compressor
description: Compress images without losing quality. Reduce file sizes for faster loading websites and optimized storage.
longDescription: Image Compressor uses advanced compression algorithms to reduce image file sizes by up to 80% while maintaining visual quality. Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF formats. Batch processing available for multiple files. Perfect for web developers optimizing assets for production.
pricingDetails: Free tier: 20 images/month, 5MB max per file. Pro: $5/month for unlimited images, 50MB max, priority processing.
